SpaceJoinPolicy.description: Who may join a space by themself.

oneOf.description: Any active non-guest member may join.
Members join only when someone adds them (the default).

default_channel_ids.description:
New default channels: 0–10 distinct public, unarchived channels of the
space; `[]` clears them.

items.description: A Sew id: a decimal string of a 64-bit time-sortable id (1 to 9223372036854775807).

description.description: Set or clear the description (≤ 300 characters; a blank one clears).

private.description:
Make the Space private (`true`: hidden from everyone outside it, `join_policy`
becomes `invite`; `open` with it is refused) or public again (`false`: `join_policy`
becomes the request's, default `open`; `invite` for an App's Space).

rules_channel_id.description:
Set or clear the rules channel: a public, unarchived text or announcement
channel of the space.

welcome_channel_id.description: Set or clear the welcome channel, with the rules channel's rules.
